page.title: My demo account
page.description: Practice with fictitious money: €100,000 initial balance, manual trades and FIFO accounting.
page.aiLinkPre: This is your manual practice account, separate from the AI proposals.
page.loadError: Could not load the demo account: {error}
page.fixtureNotice: Sample data for visual QA: without MONGODB_URI the account is not connected and recording trades will fail.

panel.intro: Practice account with a fictitious balance. You record trades with the price you enter: it is not a market execution and there is no broker connection.
panel.notWired: Server-side recording is not connected yet; the form will activate once it is.

valuation.withTotals: Totals only add up the valued ones, per currency:
valuation.noTotals: No totals: no position has a quote.
valuation.note: Options are not valued (there is no quote for their premium). Valuation only uses Finnhub and the currency verified in its listing; the rest shows N/A. It updates roughly every minute while this tab is visible (if the provider fails, it deliberately waits longer). You can also request an update with the button
valuation.refreshErrorNetwork: Could not update quotes: network or server failure.
valuation.stale: Out of date: positions have changed since the last quote check. They refresh on their own while the tab is visible, or you can request it with the button.
valuation.unavailable: Valuation not available yet: no quotes checked. They are checked on their own while the tab is visible, or you can request it with the button.

account.violationsTitle: Integrity issues in the demo account

positions.emptyDescription: The buys you record will appear here.
positions.expiredDetail: The ledger does not exercise or expire positions automatically. To record the close use the real execution date (at expiry or earlier); settling expired worthless options is not supported yet.
positions.expiresToday: Expires today ({date}, contract date): no automatic exercise or expiry; the close is recorded by hand.
positions.footnote: Realized before fees (fees only move cash). No adjustments for splits or dividends (a simplification of the demo).

ledger.emptyDescription: Use the form above to record your first simulated trade.

ticket.symbolAriaStock: Search stock by name or ticker
ticket.symbolAriaOption: Search underlying by name or ticker
ticket.searchHint: Search by name or ticker and choose: symbol and name are filled in.
ticket.expiryHint: Contract date; it does not imply it is tradable today.
ticket.formatHint: Decimals with dot or comma, no thousands separator (1234.56).
ticket.manualNote: You record an already-executed trade with the price you enter: it is not a market execution. No fee in the demo (simulated 0): it does not reproduce any broker's pricing.
ticket.summaryDisclaimer: Calculated from your inputs: it is not a quote or a market execution.

errors.nameRequired: Enter the name (or choose the company in the search).
errors.quantityInvalid: The quantity is not a valid number ({hint}).
errors.quantityInteger: The quantity must be an integer greater than zero.
errors.priceInvalid: The price is not a valid number ({hint}).
errors.pricePositive: The price must be greater than zero.
errors.executedFuture: The execution date cannot be in the future.
errors.strikeInvalid: The strike is not a valid number ({hint}).
errors.strikePositive: The strike must be greater than zero.
errors.expiryInvalid: Enter the expiry (contract date, real yyyy-mm-dd).
errors.expiredContract: The execution date is after the contract expiry: an option cannot be exercised once expired. If you are recording a historical trade, enter its real execution date.

ticket.filled: Trade recorded in the demo account.
ticket.duplicateRejected: It is already recorded as rejected with that identifier: {reason}. Fix and resubmit: it counts as a new trade.
ticket.duplicateFill: It was already recorded (same order identifier): it was not duplicated.

fx.formatHint: Decimals with dot or comma, no thousands separator (1234.56).
fx.note: Simulated conversion with the rate you enter; the demo does not query the market.
fx.amountInvalid: The amount is not a valid number ({hint}).
fx.amountPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
fx.rateInvalid: The exchange rate is not a valid number ({hint}).
fx.ratePositive: Enter the (simulated) exchange rate greater than zero.
fx.dateFuture: The conversion date cannot be in the future.
fx.filled: Conversion recorded in the demo account.
fx.duplicateRejected: It is already recorded as rejected with that identifier: {reason}. Fix and resubmit: it counts as a new trade.
fx.duplicateFill: It was already recorded (same identifier): it was not duplicated.
